function.name: run_sql
function.arguments:
{"sql":"SELECT s.cds, ss.numge1500, ss.numtsttakr,
       (ss.numge1500::numeric / NULLIF(ss.numtsttakr,0)) AS excellence_rate,
       sch.street, sch.city, sch.zip, sch.state
FROM satscores ss
JOIN schools sch ON ss.cds = sch.cdscode
JOIN (
    SELECT cds, numge1500, numtsttakr,
           (numge1500::numeric / NULLIF(numtsttakr,0)) AS rate
    FROM satscores
) s ON ss.cds = s.cds
ORDER BY excellence_rate ASC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1;"}

function.name: run_sql
function.arguments:
{"sql":"WITH k8 AS (
  SELECT f.cdscode, s.city, s.magnet, f."NSLP Provision Status"
  FROM frpm f
  JOIN schools s ON f.cdscode = s.cdscode
  WHERE f."Low Grade"='K' AND f."High Grade"='8'
),
magnet_multiple AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM k8
  WHERE magnet = 1 AND "NSLP Provision Status" = 'Multiple Provision Types'
),
city_counts AS (
  SELECT city, COUNT(*) AS school_cnt
  FROM k8
  GROUP BY city
)
SELECT 'Magnet_Multiple_Provision_Count' AS metric, cnt::text AS value FROM magnet_multiple
UNION ALL
SELECT city AS metric, school_cnt::text AS value FROM city_counts
ORDER BY metric;"}

arguments.sql:
WITH k8 AS (
  SELECT f.cdscode, s.city, s.magnet, f."NSLP Provision Status"
  FROM frpm f
  JOIN schools s ON f.cdscode = s.cdscode
  WHERE f."Low Grade"='K' AND f."High Grade"='8'
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT city) FROM k8;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.cdscode = s.cdscode
WHERE f."Low Grade"='K' AND f."High Grade"='8'
  AND s.magnet = 1
  AND f."NSLP Provision Status" = 'Multiple Provision Types'

final_sql:
WITH k8 AS (
  SELECT f.cdscode,
         s.city,
         s.magnet,
         f."NSLP Provision Status"
  FROM frpm f
  JOIN schools s ON f.cdscode = s.cdscode
  WHERE f."Low Grade" = 'K' 
    AND f."High Grade" = '8'
),
magnet_multiple AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM k8
  WHERE magnet = 1
    AND "NSLP Provision Status" = 'Multiple Provision Types'
),
city_counts AS (
  SELECT city,
         COUNT(*) AS school_cnt
  FROM k8
  GROUP BY city
),
city_total AS (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT city) AS cnt
  FROM k8
)
SELECT 'Magnet_Multiple_Provision_Count' AS metric,
       cnt::text AS value
FROM magnet_multiple
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Cities_With_K8' AS metric,
       cnt::text
FROM city_total
UNION ALL
SELECT city AS metric,
       school_cnt::text AS value
FROM city_counts
ORDER BY metric;
